title: Wren and the Confession
author: Coral Sandoval
blurb: Lior Yarrow, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
